Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent version previously healthy in production. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 with an error rate of 0.2%. args.title: checkout-api failing health checks on v2.3.1 - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Identified the problem**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west with failing health checks and an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All three production regions were rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version that had previously been healthy in production.
3. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy on v2.3.0 with a 0.2% error rate (down from 18%).
4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2) describing the failure and the rollback action; on-call has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure (and the unhealthy v2.3.1-rc in staging) is still under investigation as noted in the incident.
